dialogue.origin: 入りました。本日はよろしくお長い致します。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for being here today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 時間早めですが、始めてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early, but would it be alright to start?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。いらしてくださってありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 息子のことなんですが、ここで相談してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: It's about my son. Is it okay to talk about him here?

dialogue.origin: はい、息子さんの事なんですね。お話詳しく伺いたいので、できる範囲でお名前、性別、ご年齢、息子さんのご年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, it's about your son. To better understand the situation, could you please share, to the extent you're comfortable, your name, gender, your age, and your son's age?

dialogue.origin: 私は、50代女性　ひろです。息子は23歳です
dialogue.content: I'm Hiro, a woman in my 50s. My son is 23.

dialogue.origin: ひろさん、ありがとうございます。それで、息子さんのどんなことがお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you, Hiro. So, what specifically about your son is concerning you?

dialogue.origin: はい、去年大学を卒業して就職したんですが、半年くらいで辞めてしまったんです
dialogue.content: Well, he graduated from university last year and got a job, but he quit after about six months.

dialogue.origin: それから、仕事を探そうともしないで困っています
dialogue.content: Since then, he hasn't even tried to look for a job, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: それはご心配ですね。息子さんはお体の事情か何かで退職されたんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That must be very worrying for you. Did your son leave his job due to health reasons or something of that nature?

dialogue.origin: どうやら合わなかったみたいで、職場では随分ストレスがたまってたみたいなんです
dialogue.content: It seems like it wasn't a good fit for him, and apparently, he was under a lot of stress at work.

dialogue.origin: だんだん口数も減ってきて、今は体調も良くないみたいです
dialogue.content: He gradually became less talkative, and now he doesn't seem to be feeling well physically, either.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、職場が合わないと感じてしまったんですね。体調もあまり良くない状態になられたんですか。ご心配ですね。
dialogue.content: I see—he felt the workplace wasn't a good fit. And his physical condition hasn't been very good, either. I can see why you're concerned.

dialogue.origin: はい、とても心配しています
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm very worried.

dialogue.origin: 失礼ですが、ご家族様はお二人ですか？
dialogue.content: Forgive me for asking, but is it just the two of you in your family?

dialogue.origin: 夫もいて、2人がそりが合わなくて、毎日大変です
dialogue.content: My husband is also here, but he and my son don't get along, which makes every day difficult.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・・夫さんもご心配は同じでしょうが、男性同士と言う事で見方がきびしくなっておられるのでしょうか。板挟みのようでひろさんが大変な思いをされているのではと心配です。
dialogue.content: I see... I'm sure your husband is just as worried, but perhaps his perspective is stricter because they are both men. I'm concerned that you must be having a hard time, feeling caught in the middle.

dialogue.origin: 夫は機嫌が悪く、毎日のように怒鳴り声を出しています
dialogue.content: My husband is in a bad mood and yells almost every day.

dialogue.origin: その声でもひろさんはお疲れになってしまいますよね。。。
dialogue.content: Just hearing that must be exhausting for you...

dialogue.origin: 夫の気持ちもわかるのですが、どうすることもできません
dialogue.content: I understand how my husband feels, but there's nothing I can do about it.

dialogue.origin: 間に挟まれてお気持ちが揺れてしまうひろさんの毎日に、心が痛みます。直接、息子さんと夫さんが話し合うということにはなっていらっしゃらないようですね。。。
dialogue.content: It pains me to think of you having to go through your days caught in the middle like this. It seems your son and husband aren't talking to each other directly...

dialogue.origin: 今は、夫が不満を息子にぶつけている日々です
dialogue.content: These days, my husband just takes out his frustrations on our son.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんは黙って聞いている感じですか？
dialogue.content: And does your son just listen silently?

dialogue.origin: 激しく反発してたこともありましたが、今はちょっと、閉じこもり気味になって、聞かないようにしています
dialogue.content: He used to push back fiercely, but now he's become a bit withdrawn and tries to ignore it.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、息子さんもお辛い思いをされているのだろうなと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. I imagine your son must be going through a difficult time as well.

dialogue.origin: 見ていてつらいです
dialogue.content: It's painful to watch.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、どちらの気持ちもわかるだけにお辛いですよね。ひろさんは、今のご家族の状態をどんな風に出来たらお気持ちが少し軽くなると思いますか？
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It must be especially hard because you can see both sides. What kind of change in your family's situation do you think would make you feel a little lighter?

dialogue.origin: 息子が何をしたいのかわからなくて…
dialogue.content: I don't know what my son wants to do...

dialogue.origin: 早く人並みになってほしいです
dialogue.content: I just want him to have a normal life.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは夫さんも同じようなお気持ちだと思われますか？ご夫婦ではどんな風に話し合っておられますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you think your husband feels the same way? How do you two discuss this as a couple?

dialogue.origin: わたしたちはよくわからないんですけど、息子は”何とかスポーツ”って言うのにはまっていて、
dialogue.content: We don't really understand it, but my son is really into something called 'e-sports.'

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 昼夜逆転でゲームをしまくっているんですね。2人とも、それについては、本当に頭を抱えています
dialogue.content: He's turned his days and nights around, playing games constantly. Both of us are at our wits' end about it.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。ご両親から見てなかなか理解が出来ないとお感じなのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see. From your perspective as parents, you're finding it difficult to understand...

dialogue.origin: あの子が何を考えているのか、さっぱりわかりません
dialogue.content: I have no idea what he's thinking.

dialogue.origin: そのことについて、息子さんとお話はできないかんじですか？
dialogue.content: And you don't feel like you can talk with your son about it?

dialogue.origin: とにかく、ゲームなんてやめろ”って、夫も口酸っぱく言うんですが、やめる様子は見られません
dialogue.content: My husband keeps telling him over and over, 'Just stop playing those games,' but there's no sign he'll stop.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。。。夫さんがそのように話しかけた時、息子さんは何も言わずにゲームの出来る部屋にもどってしまったりするということでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see... So when your husband speaks to him that way, does your son just go back to his room where he plays games without saying anything?

dialogue.origin: 今では、部屋に閉じこもっていることがほとんどで、ドア越しに聞いているとは思うんですが、顔を合わせなくなってきました
dialogue.content: Now, he mostly stays shut in his room. I think he can hear us through the door, but we don't see him face-to-face anymore.

dialogue.origin: ご飯は誰もいない隙に食べるようになりました
dialogue.content: He's started eating only when no one else is around.

dialogue.origin: そういう状態では息子さんの事を見てあげられないと更にお辛くなられる事でしょうね。。。
dialogue.content: In that situation, not being able to really see how he's doing must make it even more painful for you...

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を、少し整理させていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what you've told me so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんは就職先を半年で退職して、引きこもってゲームばかりしている（E-スポーツと今はいうのがありますね）ご両親は一般的な社会人としての生活に戻ってほしいとご希望ですが、直接の話し合いが出来ず、ドアの前から夫さんが大声で説得というかお説教する毎日。ひろさんは板挟みでお辛い思いをされている。。。と言う事ですよね
dialogue.content: Your son quit his job after six months, has withdrawn to his room, and is always playing games—what's now called e-sports. You and your husband want him to return to a normal working life, but you're unable to talk to him directly. Instead, your husband lectures him loudly from outside his door every day. And you're feeling pained and caught in the middle... Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたものでしょうか…
dialogue.content: Yes... I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。私なりに感じたことをお話しさせていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Of course... Let me share some of my thoughts on the situation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 今はもしかしたら息子さん自身も、自分がどうしたら良いのかわかりかねる状態なのかもしれないと思いました。
dialogue.content: I was thinking that, at the moment, your son himself may be in a state where he doesn't quite know what he should do.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんはご両親のお考えを分かってはいると思うのです。
dialogue.content: I believe he understands what you and your husband are thinking.

dialogue.origin: 今のところ原因が分からないのですが、ご両親のご希望に添えない自分に自信を失っておられるかもしれません。
dialogue.content: While we don't know the cause at this point, he may have lost confidence in himself for not being able to meet your expectations as his parents.

dialogue.origin: そうなんでしょうか…
dialogue.content: Do you think so...?

dialogue.origin: 息子さんにお話を伺っていないので、あくまでも推測ですが、少なくとも「弱っている」状態であるようにお見受けします。
dialogue.content: I haven't spoken with your son, so this is just speculation, but it seems to me that he is in a vulnerable state, at the very least.

dialogue.origin: 親の気も知らないで、遊んでいるようにしか見えません
dialogue.content: To me, it just looks like he's playing around, oblivious to how his parents feel.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。ゲームで昼夜逆転という毎日はそう見えても当然だと思います。
dialogue.content: I understand... With his days and nights reversed from playing games, it's natural that it would look that way to you.

dialogue.origin: これで食っている人もいる。なんて、言っていて、楽天的に見えていました
dialogue.content: He'd say things like, 'Some people make a living off this,' which made him seem overly optimistic.

dialogue.origin: 嘆かわしいです
dialogue.content: It's lamentable.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、閉じこもっているばかりではなく、そんな風に話をしてくれることもあるのですね！
dialogue.content: I see. So he's not just shutting himself away; there are times he talks to you like that!

dialogue.origin: 理解に苦しみます
dialogue.content: It's hard for me to understand.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、親世代の時代にはそういう職業は一部の人のものというりかいですよね。
dialogue.content: I can see that. For our generation, that kind of profession was something only a select few could do.

dialogue.origin: 夫は、今でも公務員に戻ってくれると信じてるんですよ
dialogue.content: My husband still believes he'll go back to being a civil servant.

dialogue.origin: 公務員さんだったのですね。それはご両親としてはギャップをお感じですね。
dialogue.content: So he was a civil servant. I can imagine that feels like quite a significant gap for you as parents.

dialogue.origin: 一つお聞きしたいのですが、
dialogue.content: There's one thing I'd like to ask.

dialogue.origin: 就職に関しては息子さんもご希望で当時公務員になられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Regarding his job, did your son also want to become a civil servant at the time?

dialogue.origin: 小さいころから、ずっとその話をして育ててきたので、他の話はしたことがありません
dialogue.content: We'd been talking to him about it ever since he was small and raised him with that in mind, so we never really discussed other paths.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、息子さん自身ももしかしたらほかの可能性を考えずに学業から就職と歩まれたのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's possible that your son himself went through his studies and into employment without considering other possibilities.

dialogue.origin: それが最善だと思っていましたので。
dialogue.content: We thought it was the best path for him.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ご両親のお立場では良い人生を歩んでほしいという選択肢だったのですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, from your perspective as parents, it was the choice you made because you wanted him to have a good life.

dialogue.origin: ただ、息子さんの中ではいざ進んでみたら違ったと思われたと言う事かもしれません。
dialogue.content: However, it might be that once he actually started down that path, he felt that it wasn't right for him.

dialogue.origin: そうなのか…
dialogue.content: Maybe so...

dialogue.origin: そして、ひろさんのお気持ちを健やかな毎日に持っていきたいと私は思っています。そのためには、ひろさんの立場、息子さんの立場、夫さんの立場、すべてを今ひろさんが背負ってしまうのは無理なのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.content: And I would like to help you move toward more peaceful days. To achieve that, I think it might be too much for you to carry the burden of your position, your son's position, and your husband's position all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: 「持っていきたいは」言い方を間違えました。すみません。「健やかな毎日に向かっていただきたい」です
dialogue.content: 'Help you move toward'—my wording was a bit off. I'm sorry. I mean, 'I hope for you to be able to move toward more peaceful days.'

dialogue.origin: 誰しも違ったとは思っても、頑張るしかないんじゃないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Even if someone feels it's not the right fit for them, don't they just have to try their best anyway?

dialogue.origin: 頑張りが足りないんじゃないのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Isn't he just not trying hard enough?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、頑張って生活に合わせて行ける人もいらっしゃいますね。ご両親がそう望まれるのはごもっともだと思います。
dialogue.content: That's true, some people are able to push through and adapt to their circumstances. It's perfectly reasonable for you as parents to wish for that.

dialogue.origin: 一方で鬱などの症状で、リタイアされる方も多くいらっしゃるので、全員が努力できないこともあるのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.content: On the other hand, many people also step away from their jobs because of conditions like depression, so it may be that not everyone can push through by effort alone.

dialogue.origin: ひろさんが息子さんの将来を案じて、心が痛んでいらっしゃるのを感じて涙が出そうな気持です。
dialogue.content: I feel close to tears myself, sensing how much pain you're in as you worry about your son's future.

dialogue.origin: お辛い毎日で、たくさんの悩みが同時に感じられる今だと思うのですが、先ずは息子さんとお話ができる状態を作っていけたら良いのではないかと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I imagine you're going through difficult days, feeling weighed down by many worries at once. I think a good first step might be to try and create a situation where you can talk with your son. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: うまくできるかな
dialogue.content: I wonder if I can do it.

dialogue.origin: きっとできると思います。
dialogue.content: I'm sure you can.

dialogue.origin: 一案としては、手紙やメッセージなどでひろさんの気持ちを伝えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: As one idea, how about trying to convey your feelings in a letter or a message?

dialogue.origin: 手紙…考えてもみませんでした。
dialogue.content: A letter... I hadn't even considered that.

dialogue.origin: パソコンなどが得意な息子さんと言う事ですのでe-mailやラインなどもよいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Since you mentioned your son is good with computers, an email or a message on an app like Line might also be a good option.

dialogue.origin: いつも返信に愛想がないんですよね
dialogue.content: His replies are always so curt.

dialogue.origin: 男の子ですから、ボキャブラリーが少ないのかも（笑）先ずはお体の事、将来を心配するからこそ公務員と言ってきたこと、そして今後は（成人である事を考えても）自分で自分の道を考えていかなければならない事
dialogue.content: He's a young man, so maybe his vocabulary is just limited (laughs). First, you could mention your concern for his health, then explain that you pushed the civil servant path precisely because you were worried about his future, and finally, that from now on—especially since he's an adult—he needs to think about his own path.

dialogue.origin: そんなことを息子さんの気持ちをまず和らげて、話を聞いてくれるところに来てもらえるのは、ひろさんにしかできない事のように思います！少しずつ話していけたらひろさんのお気持ちも軽くなって行かれるのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Gently conveying these things to soften his mood and get him to a point where he's willing to listen... I feel that's something only you can do, Hiro. If you can start talking little by little, perhaps you'll start to feel a bit lighter as well.

dialogue.origin: 少しずつ、和らげる…
dialogue.content: Little by little... soften his mood...

dialogue.origin: 今はもしかしたら頑なになっておられると思うので。お手紙作戦、お出来になれそうですか？
dialogue.content: I think he might be quite stubborn right now. Do you think you could try the 'letter approach'?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、手紙なら、できそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, if it's a letter, I think I can do it.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです！さて、時間が来てしまいまいたが、やってみてまたお困りになったらいつでもご相談に来てください！
dialogue.content: That's great! Well, our time is up, but please feel free to come back and talk anytime if you try it and run into any difficulties.

dialogue.origin: はい、今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.origin: ひろさんと息子さん、夫さんが話し合えるように応援させていただきます！本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'll be rooting for you, so that you, your son, and your husband can all talk with one another. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （ロープレありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.origin: （勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (This was a great learning experience. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: （勉強になりました。終わらせていただきます！）
dialogue.content: (It was a learning experience for me, too. I'll end the session now!)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

topic.sub: 息子とのコミュニケーション問題
